Internship Finder — all of today's jobs

Built and updated daily by Vinicius Rios — about this system

This page is my own daily job-ranking system: an automated pipeline that scans a 5M+ job-posting dataset plus 159 tracked employer career pages, scores each role for fit (procurement / supply chain), employer quality and visa policy, and republishes this list every morning — 955 eligible roles today. Source code on GitHub.

2026-11-26 09:58 UTC · ranked by the pipeline score · 🛂 = employer with a stated visa policy · 5 hidden by filters

ℹ️ Legend
🛂 visa policy
employer with a stated visa policy (visa_policy: explicit_support or unclear)
🇩🇪 German required
posting requires German (german_level: required)
🇫🇷 French (signal)
posting mentions qualified French (french_level: required or preferred) — informative signal, never an exclusion; off-target market is a separate filter
🇳🇱 Dutch (signal)
posting mentions qualified Dutch (dutch_level: required or preferred) — informative signal, never an exclusion (French mirror; "fluent French OR Dutch" Mondelez)
🚫 inapplicable
the full description (hydrated from the site) revealed a German or master's requirement — job outside your profile, out of the top
⭐ N,N
average employee rating on the Kununu portal (e.g. ⭐ 4.0)
🏆 GPTW
Great Place to Work award (year in the curated map config/employer_quality.json)
🆕 new
job that did not exist in yesterday's snapshot
✅ already applied
your personal tracker status (✅ applied · 📞 interview · 🎉 offer · ❌ rejected · 🚫 withdrawn · 👁️ ignored)
🔗 dead
URL returned 404/410 on the liveness check — job probably filled/removed
⏳ / ⚠️
informational §16e signals: stated duration above the 6-month cap / posting requires active enrollment at a German university / ambiguous Werkstudent/Praktikum type (F86 — decide on the posting)
*
market estimate: salary NOT stated in the posting, estimated from the title category (praktikum.info, kununu/Indeed; curated 2026/10). The value with * is the estimate
Nd
job age in days since posted_at (>45d highlighted)
score
title fit + employer quality + visa policy − age decay; the 💼/🧪/🇪🇺 tabs re-sort by profiles with different weights (materials/EU: see docs/f36_non_de_profile.md)
EN:
offline title translation line (DE→EN dictionary; the DE original is never replaced)

Glossary DE→EN: Praktikum = internship · Werkstudent = working student · Pflichtpraktikum = mandatory internship · Beschaffung = procurement · Einkauf = purchasing · Logistik = logistics

§16e: maximum duration 6 months (AufenthG §16e Sec. 2). Praktikum under §16e does NOT require Bundesagentur für Arbeit consent (BeschV §15 No. 1) — confirm the current procedure with the consulate/Ausländerbehörde.
